description: Header file defining the AAudioServiceStreamMMAP class for managing MMAP audio streams in Android's AAudio service, including method declarations and class structure.

classes.name: AAudioServiceStreamMMAP
classes.description: Represents an exclusive mode MMAP client stream in the AAudio service, managing communication with the audio device or port.

methods.name: AAudioServiceStreamMMAP
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MMAP stream with reference to AAudioService and inService flag.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the MMAP stream with specified request parameters.

methods.name: startClient
methods.description: Starts a client with given AudioClient, attributes, and outputs a client handle.

methods.name: stopClient
methods.description: Stops the specified client using its handle.

methods.name: getTypeText
methods.description: Returns the string 'MMAP' indicating the stream type.

methods.name: pause_l
methods.description: Pauses data flow, potentially asynchronously, sending a paused event upon completion.

methods.name: standby_l
methods.description: Puts the stream into standby mode.

methods.name: exitStandby_l
methods.description: Exits standby mode with provided parcelable.

methods.name: getAudioDataDescription_l
methods.description: Retrieves audio data description into parcelable.

methods.name: startDevice
methods.description: Performs device-specific startup, returning success or error code.
